More Than a Group

A real sisterhood that gets out and lives.

Sistah-Friends exists to make it easier for women of color to meet, connect, try new things and build friendships that continue beyond a single event.

You do not need to already have a circle to join. Come alone. Bring a friend. Bring two. The purpose is to create a welcoming environment where new relationships can actually form.

💜

Connect

Meet women who want genuine friendship and real conversation.

✨

Experience

Brunch, culture, travel, wellness, outings and new adventures.

🖤

Support

Intentionally support Black-owned businesses and community partners.

🤲🏾

Give Back

Use sisterhood as a force for generosity, service and community impact.

Our Story So Far

Past & Signature Experiences

Sistah-Friends is designed around real-world experiences that give women a reason to show up, talk, laugh, and build connection.

PAST EVENT

Memorial Weekend Wine Tasting

A small-group experience centered on conversation, connection and enjoying something together.

SIGNATURE STYLE

Brunch & Conversation

Easy gatherings where women can come alone, meet new people and enjoy a welcoming social setting.

SIGNATURE STYLE

Culture, Music & Nights Out

Concerts, festivals, theater, dining and experiences that are better when you have Sistahs to go with.
